derived.changes: Selected conv-30 sessions 1 through 3 and conv-26 session 1, with eight QA records spanning LoCoMo categories 1 through 5. Category 5 is represented explicitly as unanswerable with no gold answer. Source speaker names and session wall-clock timestamps are preserved on every turn; timezone-free source values are mapped onto UTC only for deterministic Go timestamps. Each conversation declares a smoke-contract minimum of one materialized fact per session. Image metadata and generated summaries are excluded.
